en.title: The Coppery Lunar Eclipse and the Blank Testament
en.premise: After the death of a wealthy magnate who left behind a massive fortune, an inexplicable "missing will" occurs within a secluded mansion where relatives have gathered. As the narrator, I act as a "benevolent bystander," calmly observing the suspicions swirling among the kin. However, when the lunar eclipse stains the sky crimson and the world is shrouded in darkness, the reality I once believed in begins to shatter.

zh.title: 赤铜的月食与空白的遗言
zh.premise: 留下巨额遗产的富豪去世后，在亲属聚集的封闭洋馆中，发生了一起离奇的“遗嘱失踪事件”。作为叙述者的我，扮演着冷静观察亲属间疑云涌动的“善良旁观者”。然而，当月食将天空染成赤红、世界被黑暗笼罩之时，我所深信的景象开始轰然崩塌。
